review_kind: Independent non-author source and fault review

execution.compiler_and_renderer: explicit synthetic fixtures; actual short-lived Python child processes additionally test timeout/pause cancellation. No real TeX or page visual approval.

findings.trigger: Literal includegraphics in verbatim or inline verb
findings.actual: Source code examples are detected as graphics. A verbatim example can be classified simple=True and repaired; inline verb can receive printable probe text.
findings.required_outcome: Do not instrument or repair literal examples; preserve source/example semantics.
findings.resolution_evidence: Latest stable exact-source test and unit-probe results; all historical failures are retained in prior_fault_runs.

findings.trigger: A successfully generated PDF with a known extractable 5pt figure-axis label and a normal-width insertion
findings.actual: mechanical_passed=True with no typography defect queue
findings.required_outcome: Known undersized final figure text remains an open defect; do not auto-scale equations or alter semantic content.
findings.resolution_evidence: Latest stable exact-source test and unit-probe results; all historical failures are retained in prior_fault_runs.

findings.trigger: Renderer succeeds but writes PNG signature followed by garbage
findings.actual: Corrupt data can satisfy signature/length check and receive mechanical_passed=True
findings.required_outcome: Reject non-decodable or structurally invalid page renders before claiming complete rendering.
findings.resolution_evidence: Latest stable exact-source test and unit-probe results; all historical failures are retained in prior_fault_runs.

findings.trigger: Common FancyVerb inline Verb or minted mintinline code example containing includegraphics
findings.actual: See additional_literal_mode_checks; a surviving match can receive a probe inside printable code.
findings.required_outcome: Mask these literal modes or conservatively queue their source before instrumentation; retain source bytes and offsets.
findings.resolution_evidence: Latest stable exact-source test and unit-probe results; all historical failures are retained in prior_fault_runs.

confirmed_controls: Source/candidate scientific numbers, TeX math symbols and formulas preserved byte-for-byte except the exact permitted width option.
Original registry remains unchanged and no release or human visual approval is created.
Changed figure hash invalidates the proof before copying a repaired candidate.
An unresolved-reference queue prevents a pass even after the width is fixed.
A two-page PDF with only one page rendered cannot pass.
Existing author suite verifies output protection, pause/deadline stops, round bounds and failed recompile behavior.
Actual child-process execution is terminated promptly on a one-second time budget and a runtime pause, independently of compiler fixtures.
limitations: TeX compiler/renderer fixtures certify control flow and fault rejection, not actual TeX or final page visual quality; real short-lived child processes exercise timeout/pause cancellation.
The lexical filter is deliberately conservative and is not a full interpreter for arbitrary TeX macro or catcode behavior.
Font inspection covers extractable text. Raster, outlined, ambiguous or complex-size figure labels remain explicit review items; mathematical scripts require context decisions.
No scientific validity, citation, anonymity, contest submission or human release gate was signed.

fix_difference_review: Lexical masking retains original offsets and only governs audit/probe recognition; candidate replacements still use exact-byte and SHA preconditions.
Final PDF font checks add open defects and do not resize symbols, equations or data.
Normal-sized executed graphics now receive measured-size audits as well as oversized graphics.
PNG verification fully decodes images and checks expected full-page dimensions at 110dpi.
Width repair remains the sole permitted source replacement; original and registry protection and human release gates remain in place.
review_conclusion: Current exact-source fault review passes 22 author and 12 independent tests, including real child-process pause/timeout control. Four independent PDF-font unit cases confirm TeX-pt/PDF-bp separation. Root still must conduct actual demo compile and assembled-page visual review.

mathematical_script_review.classification: Context review, not an automatic body-font violation finding
mathematical_script_review.confirmed: A necessary 7pt mathematical script is queued as small_text_context_review with an explicit no-enlargement/no-semantic-change constraint; source formula, symbols and numbers remain byte-identical.

custom_literal_closure_review.confirmed: A declaration in an input child disables probes and automatic replacements across the full literal input closure and leaves an open unsupported_literal_syntax queue.

font_unit_review.conclusion: The assembled report audits a 12 TeX-pt body threshold in PDF units; figure contracts keep their separate 12 PDF-bp threshold. This change corrects units and does not loosen the source-figure contract or accept a 5bp label.
